form.title: Business Development Manager (IT Services)
responsibilities: be responsible for lead generation, client acquisition, relationship management, and sales strategy execution across target markets.
Identify and develop new business opportunities for DBA services across diverse industries.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of leads through networking, cold calling, attending industry events, and leveraging digital tools.
Understand client needs and propose tailored DBA service solutions, including managed services, consulting, and project-based offerings.
Develop proposals, respond to RFPs, and deliver effective sales presentations and demonstrations.
Collaborate closely with technical teams to design customized solutions that align with client requirements.
Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms to close deals successfully.
Maintain and grow relationships with existing clients to ensure ongoing satisfaction and identify upsell opportunities.
Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
Provide regular reporting on sales pipeline, forecasts, and market feedback to leadership.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies (cloudnative databases, automation, security), and competitive landscape.

that align with client requirements.

feedback to leadership.
